evidence.text: Labu dan Labi( Labu and Labi) is a 1962 Singaporean buddy comedy film directed by and starring P. Ramlee.

evidence.title: Labu dan Labi
evidence.text: The movie was filmed in Singapore and it revolves around the antics of Labu and Labi, two servants with wild imaginations who work in the house of a wealthy but miserly man, Haji Bakhil bin Haji Kedekut.

evidence.title: Labu dan Labi
evidence.text: The movie is filmed in the style of a stage pantomime, with over- the- top comedy and featuring the characters occasionally talking directly to the audience.

evidence.title: Labu dan Labi
evidence.text: The film's sequel is" Nasib Si Labu LabiThe Fate of Labu and Labi" or" What Happened to Labu and Labi").

evidence.title: Nasib Si Labu Labi
evidence.text: Nasib Si Labu Labi (The Fate of Labu and Labi, colloquially What Happened to Labu and Labi) is a 1963 Malaysian buddy comedy film directed by and starring P. Ramlee.

evidence.title: Nasib Si Labu Labi
evidence.text: The film is a sequel to "Labu dan Labi" and features a number of returning cast members.
